data.name: 5Hour Multiple  Sandbar Hangout Boston Whaler
data.headline: Up to 6 Guests • Sandbar Hangout
data.description:
#This charter is highly recommended for bachelor / bachelorettes and birthdays for more time under the sun!
			

##What's Included				
- Captain
- Fuel
- Cooler and ice
- Bottled water
- Soda and chips	
- SunChill Island Float 
			

##The Vessel					
- Newer Bow-rider
- Boston Whaler "The unsinkable legend"
- 230 Vantage
- Plenty of comfortable seating for 6 passengers.
- Bow seating area with lounge backrest / sun pad area.
- Shade lounger / bench seat
- Additional to make this boat ride even better
- Bluetooth radio connection 
- Fresh water boat shower
- Prep station with fresh water sink 
- Large shaded area					

##Our mission				
Let's get away from reality and explore what it feels to be out of cell phone range in Paradise!

meeting_point.address: 811 Palm Ave Cswy #10 Key West, FL US 33040
